formulationText: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not a real product. Vitamin AD3E premix, oral liquid. Each 1 liter contains Vitamin A 500000 IU, Vitamin D3 75000 IU, Vitamin E 500 mg.
aimOfUseHint: A source of vitamins A, D3 and E to support growth and fertility in cattle
directionOfUseHint: 5ml per 100kg body weight, once daily in drinking water for 3-5 days
